query: Oracle OCI AI revenue growth fiscal 2025 quarter May 2025
normalized: 2025 ai fiscal growth may oci oracle quarter revenue

output.content:
For Oracle’s fiscal Q4 2025—the quarter ended May 31, 2025—OCI consumption revenue grew **62% year over year**; Oracle did not separately disclose an “AI revenue” dollar amount or a standalone AI-revenue growth rate in its earnings release. [[1]] 

The broader OCI/IaaS revenue measure was **$3.0 billion, up 52% year over year**, while combined cloud revenue (IaaS plus SaaS) was **$6.7 billion, up 27%**. [[2]] 

Management attributed the OCI demand acceleration to AI-related workloads and said it expected OCI consumption growth to accelerate further in fiscal 2026. [[3]]
